name: OpenMausBot
description: Open-source Grok Bot alternative with a virtual machine that bots can use
one_liner: A free desktop chat app where every contact in your sidebar is actually its own AI assistant, each with its own personality and a computer it can work from.
buyer: A solopreneur or tiny agency owner who wants a 'team of AI employees' they can talk to like Slack contacts, without paying for a pile of separate AI subscriptions.
business_use_cases: A solopreneur sets up named 'staff' bots (ops, research, support) and charges clients a flat monthly fee to run parts of their business through it.
An agency white-labels it internally and sells 'AI employee' seats to small-business clients who can't afford to hire real staff.
A productized-service shop builds one specific persona on top of it (e.g. an 'AI bookkeeper' bot) and sells it as a subscription to local businesses.

money_ideas.idea: Managed 'AI staff' service built on top of custom bot personas
One-off custom persona setup for a client's specific workflow

steal_this: Set up two or three bot personas (a scheduler, an inbox-triager, a research assistant) this weekend and sell access as a $29/month 'your first AI employees' bundle to a few local business owners.
